nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) holding token balances for every account.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) storing spender allowances.
Total token supply, initialized to 10*10**9*10**18 at declaration.
Token name string ' Secret Meme Coin '.
Token symbol 'SMC'.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Ownable owner address; written in constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Address captured from _msgSender() at deployment; used by onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner.
SecretMEME constructor: assigns the entire _tTotal supply to _msgSender() in _balances and emits Transfer.
Public view returning _name.
Public view returning _symbol.
Public view returning _decimals.
Private approval routine; zeroes the allowance (and emits Approval with value 4) whenever the owner argument is not owner().
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
External ERC20 approve; forwards _msgSender() and spender to _approve.
External ERC20 transferFrom; calls _transfer then _approve with the decremented allowance.
Public view returning _tTotal.
Public view returning _balances[account].
External ERC20 transfer; calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Internal balance-moving routine using SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
Ownable function guarded by onlyOwner that sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable function guarded by onlyOwner that reassigns _owner to newOwner.
Public view returning _owner.
Modifier requiring newComer == _msgSender(); note it checks the deployment-time address, not _owner.
Library helper that performs a low-level value call to a payable recipient.
Private library helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value and returndata bubbling.
Library view using extcodehash to test whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender() and used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") executed in Address.sendValue before any state consistency check.
Low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue, carrying user-supplied calldata.
Silent allowance reset to zero for any approver that is not owner(), a privileged state mutation inside _approve.
uint256 amount parameter of approve/transfer/transferFrom.
address spender parameter of approve/allowance.
address recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
address sender parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
address account parameter of balanceOf.
address owner parameter of allowance().
Local address msgSender = _msgSender() used to seed _owner and _balances in the constructor.
address ol (approver) parameter of private _approve.
address tt (spender target) parameter of private _approve.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender via _msgSender() to mint the whole supply.
approve passes _msgSender() as the approving address into _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() both as spender and as the address whose allowance is decreased.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of funds.
onlyOwner compares the caller (_msgSender()) against newComer, so the authorization check depends on caller identity.
Constructor writes the full supply into _balances[_msgSender()].
Constructor reads _tTotal when minting the initial balance.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
_approve writes _allowances[ol][tt].
_approve branches on the result of owner(), i.e. on _owner.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient.
Constructor local msgSender is used as the key when writing _balances.
onlyOwner reads the deployment-time newComer storage variable to authorize callers.
owner() returns _owner.
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with address(0).
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with newOwner.
_approve uses the amount parameter (or forces it to zero) when storing the allowance.
_transfer subtracts and adds the amount parameter to _balances.
_approve stores the spender key tt derived from the spender parameter.
_transfer credits the recipient parameter in _balances.
_transfer debits the sender parameter in _balances.
balanceOf uses the account parameter as the mapping key.
allowance uses the owner parameter as the first mapping key.
_approve uses the ol parameter as the allowance owner key.
_approve uses the tt parameter as the allowance spender key.
transfer delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before touching allowances.
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance.
approve calls the private _approve routine.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
_approve takes the privileged branch that zeroes a non-owner allowance and emits Approval with value 4.
Address.sendValue executes an external low-level value call before validating success.
Address._functionCallWithValue performs an external low-level call with attacker-controlled calldata.
_functionCallWithValue first validates the target with isContract.
The recipient's fallback can reenter sendValue while the value transfer is still being processed.
The called target can reenter _functionCallWithValue before returndata handling completes.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to size the balance updates performed inside _transfer.
The spender parameter is only consumed as the allowance mapping key written by _approve.
The recipient parameter is only used as the credited key inside _transfer.
The sender parameter is only used as the debited key inside _transfer.
The account parameter is only used as the _balances lookup key in balanceOf.
The owner parameter is only used as the first _allowances lookup key in allowance.
The msgSender local is a temporary alias of _msgSender() used solely to write _owner and _balances in the constructor.
The ol parameter is only the approver key used by the private _approve routine.
The tt parameter is only the spender key used by the private _approve routine.
